sections.h2: India's Russian crude imports peaked at 2.82 million bpd in July, then eased

chart.title: Russian crude arrivals rose through mid-year, then eased from August
chart.sub: Million barrels a day. July to October figures are Kpler's preliminary estimates.
chart.source: Kpler, LSEG, as reported by Indian and international business press.

sections.means: Kpler's ship-tracking data shows Russian crude arrivals at 2.82 million bpd in July before easing to about 1.97 million in October.
sections.todo: Check the latest Kpler revision before quoting any single month, since preliminary cargo counts keep moving.

sections.h2: Used cooking oil processed into biodiesel grew from 49 to 70 thousand tonnes

chart.title: Used cooking oil processed into biodiesel grew from 49 to 70 thousand tonnes
chart.sub: Thousand metric tonnes of feedstock actually processed into biodiesel, not total UCO generated.
chart.source: Invest India briefing, compiling USDA (2023) data.

sections.means: Used cooking oil processed into biodiesel grew from 49 to 70 thousand tonnes between 2013 and 2022, while its share of the total held roughly flat.
sections.todo: Reconcile the 1.8 to 2.6 million and 3 million tonne UCO generation estimates with a single collection-based figure before using either.

sections.h2: India's biodiesel blend was 0.07% in 2022, far short of the 5% target for 2030

chart.title: India's biodiesel blend sits far below its 5% target for 2030
chart.sub: Actual blend rate and national target, in percent.
chart.source: Invest India briefing; 2018 National Biofuels Policy.

sections.means: India's actual biodiesel blend rate was 0.07% in 2022, up from 0.02% in 2021, against a 5% target for 2030.
sections.todo: Track the actual blend rate against the 2030 target each year, using the same measure for both.

sections.h2: Record VLCC earnings in September contrast with a 56% fall in LNG carrier rates

chart.title: Tanker day rates spiked in September while LNG carrier rates fell
chart.sub: US dollars per day. The VLCC figure is a mid-September snapshot; the LNG figure is a 2026 spot rate.
chart.source: Hellenic Shipping News, ship-broker reporting; Clarksons Research.

sections.means: A VLCC earned about $451,000 a day in mid-September, while Clarksons put standard LNG carrier spot rates at about $24,606 a day in 2026, down 56%.
sections.todo: Compare freight rates over the same time window before reading the tanker and LNG markets against each other.
